[1/1] Switch AIKit from MIT to AGPL-3.0: replace LICENSE with the canonical AGPL text, update the README license line, record ADR-151, run the full delivery gates, commit and push non-destructively

impact_assessment.why: The project portfolio now uses AGPL-3.0, but AIKit itself, NeuralBeat and VoidFarer still expose MIT, Apache-2.0 and no license respectively, so the public repositories are inconsistent and GitHub cannot advertise the intended license
impact_assessment.benefits: One license across the portfolio, correct GitHub license detection, an explicit legal contract in every repository, and README/ADR records that match the shipped LICENSE
impact_assessment.risks: contract: AIKit moves from permissive MIT to copyleft AGPL-3.0; dependency: none; concurrency: another session may touch the shared root; state: no runtime state changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use the canonical AGPL-3.0 text already staged in agpl_text.txt, keep the change to LICENSE/README/ADR, run the full AIKit gate set, stage explicitly, and push only after the commit is verified; abort on unrelated working-tree drift

[1/3] Artifact hygiene: status --exit-code and narrow untracked/tracked artifact scan

impact_assessment.why: Lacon's untracked root test module is imported by unittest discovery while status exits 0 and hygiene reports clean (PRINCIPLE-006, PRINCIPLE-014 R4).
impact_assessment.benefits: Makes delivery readiness machine-readable; catches root test modules, untracked outputs and tracked caches; no new dependency.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new status flags and hygiene rules; dependency: git is already required for projects; concurrency: read-only git queries; state: no writes to the scanned tree
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the scan read-only and decidable; unit-test pure classifiers; integration-test a Lacon-shaped temp repo; wire no default behavior change before pilot

[1/2] Opt-in UI surface guard in AIKit plus user-approved README ceiling 22,500

impact_assessment.why: AI UI edits can drift outside a reviewed surface and compound on a broken baseline; dogfooding only detects process failures after the fact.
impact_assessment.benefits: Any project can bound UI edits to one committed surface with protected paths, a diff budget, a green baseline, an atomic task record and a backup-preserving abort; no browser or framework enters AIKit.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new opt-in CLI and ui.json schema; dependency: stdlib plus project-declared commands; concurrency: atomic task state under file_lock; state: .aikit/ui_task.json is bookkeeping
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit tests with injected git, one real-git integration test, CLI smoke test, ADR-158/159, map and full gate shield; no default gate change.
